The source file (src), alternative text (alt),width, andheightare provided as attributes: Have you ever seen a Web page and wondered "Hey! How did they do that?" Click CTRL + U in an HTML page, or right-click on the page and select "View Page Source". This will open a new tab containing the HTML source code of the page. Right-click on an element (or a blank area), and choose "Inspect" to see what elements are made up of (you will see both the HTML and the CSS).
